rules.title: Subscription leak
rules.description: subscribe() without takeUntilDestroyed(), async pipe, or explicit unsubscribe — leaks on component destroy.

rules.title: Heavy work in template binding
rules.description: Method calls or expensive getters in template bindings re-run on every change detection cycle. Use signals, pure pipes, or precomputed fields.

rules.title: Direct DOM access
rules.description: document.* or nativeElement manipulation instead of Renderer2 — breaks SSR and sanitization.

rules.title: ngFor without trackBy
rules.description: *ngFor over changing lists without trackBy forces full DOM re-render of the list.

rules.title: Business logic in template
rules.description: Complex expressions, null-chains with side effects, or data transformation embedded in the template instead of the component/pipe.
